gloss: to flinch; to falter; to recoil

definitions.gloss: to flinch; to falter; to recoil
definitions.explanation: To hesitate, waver, or draw back momentarily due to fear, surprise, or intimidation.

examples.japanese: {厳|きび}しい{批判|ひはん}を{受|う}けてもたじろがなかった。
examples.english: He didn't flinch even when receiving harsh criticism.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}の{迫力|はくりょく}にたじろいだ。
examples.english: I faltered at my opponent's intensity.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{困難|こんなん}を{前|まえ}にしてもたじろぐことなく{前進|ぜんしん}した。
examples.english: She moved forward without faltering even when facing difficulties.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). No pair verb.

USAGE:
たじろぐ describes a momentary hesitation or wavering, often psychological rather than purely physical. It implies a temporary loss of confidence or resolve in the face of something daunting.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜にたじろぐ (to flinch at ~)
・たじろぐことなく (without flinching)
・たじろがない (doesn't flinch - shows resolve)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・ひるむ - to cower/flinch (stronger fear, more about backing down)
・{怯|ひる}む - same as above (kanji form)
・ためらう - to hesitate (more about indecision)
・おののく - to tremble (stronger fear response)
